mcp.autonomyHint: What an AI assistant connected with this key may do without your approval. You can change it later from "API keys".
mcp.autonomyManual: Manual approval (every write waits for your approval)
mcp.autonomyAutonomous: Autonomous (reversible actions run without approval; the others always wait)
mcp.autonomyAutonomousWarning: With an autonomous key the assistant can publish without review. Every action is journalled and can be undone from the audit log; a deletion always waits for your approval.

apiKeys.autonomyLabel: Autonomy of an assistant connected over MCP
apiKeys.autonomyHint: No effect on the REST API: it only concerns AI assistants connected with this key.
apiKeys.autonomyManual: Manual approval (every write waits for your approval)
apiKeys.autonomyAutonomous: Autonomous (reversible actions run without approval; the others always wait)
apiKeys.autonomyAutonomousWarning: With an autonomous key the assistant can publish without review. Every action is journalled and can be undone from the audit log; a deletion always waits for your approval.
